policy: See tests/validation_data/corpus.py. development: free to tune on. calibration: feeds a shipped statistical artifact. test: frozen - evaluate only.

sheba.description: Grenfell & Light (2007) SHEBA 1998 spectral albedo, 76N. VIS 400-1000 nm (ALBV) + SWIR 1100-2005 nm (ALBI).
sheba.used_for: Everything: emulator ranges, band masks, seasonal priors and the FYI_snow temperature bound were all set against it. Also in the model-error calibration. Numbers quoted from it are in-sample.

morassutti.description: Morassutti (1995) melt-pond spectral albedo, NSIDC G01169. 504 records, 6 bands 400-1000 nm.
morassutti.used_for: Melt-pond forward model and FYI_pond emulator design (pond-floor coarseness, pond-surface interface). In-sample for ponds.

macfarlane.description: Macfarlane et al. (2022) MOSAiC micro-CT snow/SSL structure profiles, summer 2020.

smith.description: Smith et al. (2021) MOSAiC Leg 4 2020 spectral albedo, 82N. ASD 350-2500 nm.
smith.used_for: Calibrates the forward-model error covariance (data/model_error/field_se_v1.npz) together with SHEBA. Was an independent hold-out until 2026-07; numbers quoted from it since are in-sample for S_e, and it has also informed forward-model experiments (D2).

istomina.description: Istomina, Nicolaus & Perovich (2016) IceArc 2012 spectral albedo. ASD 350-2500 nm.
istomina.used_for: Frozen test set. Held out of the model-error calibration; never used to set a forward-model, emulator, prior, mask or threshold choice.
